_comment: GENERATED by scripts/generate-mechanism-inventory.ts — do not edit. What each shipped PKCS#11 WASM engine ADVERTISES (rung 1 of the claim ladder), not what it passes. inventorySha256 = SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the engine-reported fields only (type, infoRv, ulMinKeySize, ulMaxKeySize, flags). requiredOperations = the operation probes the advertised flags make required (WS-G G-2); no probe is implied to exist or pass. sourceCommit is copied from public/wasm/wasm-provenance.json, not verified against the binary. crossEngine lists advertisement-level disagreements between the two engines (findings, not verdicts).
